question: What serves as the ultimate authority for all beings and all scriptures, O great goddess?
premises: Something is declared the authority for all beings.
It is also the authority for scriptures and so forth.
The goddess is addressed as witness or recipient.
inference: The revealed reality is the authority for all beings and all scriptures.
uncertainties: The subject functioning as pramāṇaṃ is carried over from context.
plain_english: O great goddess, it is the authority for all beings and for the scriptures and so forth.
